_about: Round 16 (2026-11-26): real recordings for common sounds (Anthony: 'yes on 6 too'). Current is the round 14 winner (layered effects, pro mix), every sound generated. Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json and variants_layers.json.

variants.label: Real recordings, only exact matches
variants.why: Each key moment and the room background is looked for in the library of real recordings first. Claude uses a recording only when it is the same thing making the same sound. On this video nothing in the library was an exact match, so every sound was still generated: this one should sound the same as Current.

variants.label: Real recordings that sound right
variants.why: Claude chooses like a foley artist: a real recording is used when it would sound right, even if something else made it (a heavy thud on carpet for the vacuum nozzle landing). The sounds it cannot match are generated as before.

variants.label: Real recordings that sound right, key moments only
variants.why: The same, but the steady background of the room stays generated.
